title: Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 — Digital Product Passport framework
scope_note: ESPR establishes the horizontal DPP framework. Product-specific DPP content, data carrier details, granularity and access rights are specified through applicable delegated acts or other Union legislation. REGIQ does not infer a product-specific legal obligation where no applicable act has been identified.

provisions.title: DPP data must be accurate, complete and up to date
provisions.summary: Where a DPP is required by an applicable delegated act, the passport data must be accurate, complete and up to date.

provisions.title: Product-specific DPP content is defined by applicable acts
provisions.summary: Applicable delegated acts specify the data, data carrier, positioning, granularity and customer access arrangements for covered product groups.

provisions.title: Persistent unique product identifier
provisions.summary: The DPP is connected through a data carrier to a persistent unique product identifier.

provisions.title: Data carrier associated with the product
provisions.summary: The data carrier is physically present on the product, packaging or accompanying documentation as specified by the applicable act.

provisions.title: Open and interoperable data
provisions.summary: DPP data is based on open standards and designed to be interoperable and, where appropriate, machine-readable, structured, searchable and transferable without vendor lock-in.

provisions.title: End-to-end DPP interoperability
provisions.summary: The technical, semantic and organisational design supports interoperability with other DPPs required under ESPR delegated acts.

provisions.title: Free and easy access according to access rights
provisions.summary: Relevant actors have free and easy access to the DPP according to access rights established by the applicable act.
